correctness.rationale: Exactly 458 independent sets with even/odd dimensions 232/226. The 168 collineations have 13/14 configuration-orbit counts, forcing odd-side corank at least one. Exact integer ranks are 155 at t=0 and 216 at t=1, with sign-gauge equivalence for -1. Two explicitly indexed 225-minor determinants have certified integer polynomial forms with factors t^80(t^2-1)^9(t^2-5)Q(t)^6 and t^80(t^2-1)^9(5t^2-1)Q(t)^6, respectively. The common degree-eight factor is positive for all nonzero real t by the u=t^2+t^-2 >=2 substitution. The two other factors never vanish together. Therefore rank is 225 everywhere else; nullity equals 458-2rank, yielding 148/26/8. The polynomial equalities were checked with 226 evaluations over each of 12 primes and coefficient bounds strong enough to lift exact integer identities; independently labelled exact integer elimination agreed.

value.rationale: The Heawood graph is the smallest canonical Fano-plane incidence network; shore-specific Rydberg driving is its natural two-parameter symmetry-preserving perturbation. The sharp all-real-parameter eight-to-twenty-six zero-mode switch and singular zero-drive limit distinguish symmetrically protected and accidental mid-spectrum degeneracies. The result includes a nontrivial 168-element orbit-count mechanism and exact polynomial lower-rank certificates, not just a numerical table or an unmotivated single-parameter slice.
